movies.desc_12: The film follows Wang Wei (Xie Miao), a mute salesman living in Hong Kong with his daughter Rainy (Yang Enyou). One day, Rainy is kidnapped by a human trafficking ring. Wei seeks help from the police but is rejected as they are corrupt. Thus, Wei begins a relentless quest for revenge to rescue his daughter. He teams up with Navin (Joe Taslim), a journalist whose wife went missing while investigating the same human trafficking ring.
movies.desc_11: To gain views, a group of streamers livestreams the exploration of the 'Fire Building', an abandoned mansion associated with the legend of the Hua family ghost. But from the very first minutes, everything spirals out of control. Supernatural phenomena occur in succession, pulling the group into an inescapable vortex of obsession. The livestream quickly turns into a place of 'karmic retribution,' where each person must pay for their greed and blasphemy against the aggrieved soul of the young lady of the Hua family.
movies.title_10: BTS World Tour 'Arirang' In Busan: Live Viewing
movies.desc_10: A historic journey continues to be written. After the record-breaking kickoff of the 'ARIRANG' World Tour, pop icons BTS will return to the Busan Asiad Main Stadium for a special concert, broadcast live to cinemas worldwide. This is also an emotional return to the very venue where the group performed with all members for the last time 3 years and 8 months ago before their military service. Traversing 34 cities with 85 shows, this tour sets a new milestone as the largest-scale tour ever undertaken by a Korean artist. More specifically, the concert takes place on June 13 — BTS's debut anniversary — making the event even more meaningful as the group looks back on the series of achievements they have built together and looks toward the future. Titled 'ARIRANG', the tour accompanies BTS's fifth studio album, intertwining honest introspective perspectives with universal themes of longing and deep love — the elements that make up the group's unique identity. With a signature, overwhelming 360-degree stage design, the concert provides an immersive experience, making the audience a part of that celebratory moment. Immerse yourself in the explosive moments of BTS's iconic return on the big screen worldwide — with 2 major events: June 13 and June 14, LIVE FROM BUSAN. The new film BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN BUSAN: LIVE VIEWING will have LIVE screenings at 16:45 on June 13 and REBROADCAST screenings at 16:45 on June 14, 2026, at cinemas nationwide.
movies.title_9: Doraemon Movie 45 (2026): Nobita and the Castle of the Deep Sea
movies.desc_9: Entering summer vacation, Nobita and his friends argue about where to go camping. At Doraemon's suggestion, the group decides to camp in the middle of the ocean! Using magic gadgets like the 'underwater Buggy' and 'adaptation flashlight,' the five friends enjoy their underwater camping trip, meeting countless fascinating creatures along the way. After discovering a shipwreck, the group meets a mysterious young man named El. To their surprise, he is an undersea resident living in the 'Mu Federation,' a vast undersea region! Deeply hostile toward surface dwellers, the undersea residents cannot trust Nobita and his friends. Just then, the announcement 'The Devil's Castle... has begun to resurrect!!' is broadcast. What exactly is this 'Devil's Castle' that terrifies the undersea residents? Placing full trust in their friends, the grand adventure that decides the fate of the earth begins!
movies.desc_8: John Wick finds a way to defeat the High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and old friends turned foes.
movies.desc_7: To save his job, David Ticoule agrees to transport a mysterious package from South America to France. He brings his son Léo and ex-wife Tess along, accidentally dragging them into a dangerous mission he doesn't even fully understand yet. From what was supposed to be a simple trip, the journey at sea turns into a series of hilarious and chaotic situations.
movies.desc_6: Set in 1457 during the Joseon Dynasty, Under the Queen's Umbrella depicts the tragic fate of King Danjong, the sixth monarch of the dynasty (played by Park Ji-hoon). Ascending the throne at a young age, Danjong quickly becomes a pawn in a brutal power struggle. Overthrown, deposed, and exiled to the remote region of Cheongnyeongpo by his own uncle, the young king's life takes a melancholic turn. In exile, he meets village head Eom Heung Do (played by Yoo Hai-jin), who proactively turns the poor village into a prison for the king in exchange for the hope of saving the villagers' livelihoods. From two seemingly opposite stations—a former emperor and a commoner—the film gradually reveals a quiet but profound connection, where loyalty, silent protection, and small lives drift together amidst the great waves of history.
movies.desc_5: Living in extreme poverty and terrified of losing another child after a miscarriage, the lives of Phu and Thao (who is pregnant) become darker than ever when Phu's mother passes away due to lack of money for treatment. In despair, Thao listens to Mrs. Tanh, a neighbor who works as a ritualist, and decides to perform a ceremony to summon a 'wandering ghost' to serve as a house spirit to guard the home and protect the unborn child. When the entity in the corner begins to 'collect its debt,' Thao realizes in horror: the thing she brought home to protect her family is actually an inescapable nightmare.
movies.desc_4: The story follows Quan, a husband devastated by the sudden death of his wife. Happiness seems to be reborn when his wife's soul 'returns' in the body of his colleague, who survived the accident that took his wife's life. Like hermit crabs, they both cling to and depend on a different shell to survive, as well as to try to avoid the pain of life. The brief joy vanishes when a horrifying secret related to his wife's death is revealed, placing Quan before a choice: continue to cling to and accept the shell of self-created happiness, or uncover the terrifying truth inside this very shell.

newsData.news_1_title: Live Viewing BTS World Tour "Arirang" In Busan in Vietnam
newsData.news_1_desc: Experience the biggest K-Pop concert in history by BTS, broadcast live on the big 4K screen with cinema-standard surround sound.
newsData.news_1_content:
A historic journey continues to be written. Global pop icons BTS will return to the Busan Asiad Main Stadium for a special concert named "ARIRANG". The concert will be broadcast live (Live Viewing) to D-Cinema theaters nationwide on June 13 and 14, 2026.

Showtime details:

  • LIVE Screening (Live broadcast): 16:45 on 13.06.2026
  • REBROADCAST Screening: 16:45 on 14.06.2026

Ultimate cinema experience:

Audiences will be immersed in a spectacular musical space with an overwhelming 360-degree stage design. Crisp 4K image quality and D-Cinema's top-tier surround sound system make you feel like you're standing right in the Busan stadium.

Especially, each movie ticket comes with 01 exclusive gift set including photocards of BTS members and official commemorative stickers. Army Bombs (lightsticks) are also encouraged to be brought into the screening room to create beautiful synchronized lighting effects.
newsData.news_2_title: Doraemon Movie 45: Nobita and the Castle of the Deep Sea premieres 2026
newsData.news_2_desc: The 45th theatrical movie of the robot cat Doraemon takes Nobita's group on an adventure to explore the vast ocean and face a great challenge.
newsData.news_2_content:
Entering a vibrant summer vacation, Doraemon and Nobita's group made a bold decision: camping in the middle of the deep ocean! Thanks to Doraemon's magical gadgets like the “underwater Buggy” and “adaptation flashlight”, the 5 friends had an exciting adventure in the deep sea.

Here, they discover a mysterious shipwreck and meet El - a young man living in the ancient undersea federation named "Mu". After initial conflicts, the group gradually gained the trust of the ocean dwellers through their courage and sincerity.

However, a huge threat arrives when the "Devil's Castle" at the bottom of the sea begins to resurrect and threatens the survival of the entire Earth. Nobita and his friends must unite to save the world.

Doraemon Movie 45 promises to bring profound meaningful lessons about friendship, marine environment protection along with extremely sparkling and beautiful graphics. The movie officially premieres at all D-Cinema systems with many attractive Doraemon-themed popcorn combo offers!
newsData.news_3_title: Review Ghost of the Fire Building: Streamers break into the haunted ancient villa of the Hua family
newsData.news_3_desc: Thrilling plot, terrifying karma of streamers seeking views at the most famous abandoned villa in Saigon.
newsData.news_3_content:
Ghost of the Fire Building is a Vietnamese spiritual horror film attracting huge public attention. The movie follows a group of young streamers who decide to break into the Fire Building - an ancient abandoned villa associated with the urban legend of the Hua family ghost - for the purpose of livestreaming for views and money.

However, right from the first minutes of stepping into the villa, supernatural phenomena continuously occur beyond control. The fun livestream quickly turns into a terrifying battle for survival, forcing each member to face their own hidden past sins.

Major plus points of the movie:

  • Gloomy, realistic atmosphere: The movie does a great job recreating the eerie, gloomy look of the ancient villa with long corridor camera angles.
  • Excellent sound: Whispers, footsteps and dramatic background music make viewers constantly startled and get goosebumps.
  • Solid acting: The cast of Tran Ky Anh, Nguyen Minh Thoi and Ngoc Chi Bao successfully portrayed the characters' extreme panic and fear.

Despite some minor flaws in resolving the movie's ending knot, Ghost of the Fire Building is still an incredibly worthwhile Vietnamese horror work this summer. Come to the nearest D-Cinema and experience ultimate fear!
newsData.news_4_title: Student Monday - Flat 2D ticket price of only 45,000 VND for Students
newsData.news_4_desc: Kick off the new week full of energy with D-Cinema. Bring your Student ID to get discounted movie tickets every Monday.
newsData.news_4_content:
To give more motivation to students after stressful study hours, D-Cinema brings a super attractive periodic promotion program named Student Monday.

Offer details:

  • Flat 2D ticket price: Only 45,000 VND/ticket for all showing movies (applicable before 17:00 every Monday).
  • Popcorn combo offer: Extra 20% discount when buying Combo Solo or Combo Couple with the ticket.

Conditions apply:

Customers just need to present a valid Student ID (or VNeID personal identification app for students without an ID) at the D-Cinema ticket counter to receive this discounted ticket price. Each ID can purchase a maximum of 02 promotional tickets per day.

The program does not apply concurrently with other promotions or special screenings/IMAX, VIP rooms. Schedule now with your best friends so you don't miss this week's Monday cinema festival!
newsData.news_5_title: D-Cinema Sense City Can Tho opens IMAX Laser screening room
newsData.news_5_desc: Bringing the world's most modern cinema technology with superior contrast and immersive 12-channel sound to the Western audience.
newsData.news_5_content:
A new milestone in the journey of elevating the Vietnamese cinematic experience: D-Cinema officially puts the first IMAX Laser screening room into operation at the Sense City Can Tho branch.

The new generation IMAX projection system uses advanced Laser light sources, providing ultra-sharp resolution images, superior deep contrast over 60% compared to standard cinemas, opening up an incredibly realistic and vivid cinematic world.

Besides, IMAX's new generation 12-channel sound system brings maximum audio power and precise sound positioning, helping viewers clearly feel every smallest sound detail, from rustling falling leaves to earth-shattering explosions of blockbuster action movies.

During the opening week from June 10 to June 18, 2026, all customers buying IMAX Laser tickets will participate in a 100% winning lucky spin program with attractive gifts such as: limited edition IMAX water bottle, free movie voucher, and premium popcorn combo.
newsData.news_6_title: Fan Meeting & Exchange with the cast of Under the Queen's Umbrella
newsData.news_6_desc: Opportunity to exchange and receive posters signed by the director and main stars at D-Cinema Landmark 81.
newsData.news_6_content:
Welcoming the Korean box office fever in Vietnam, D-Cinema is proud to organize an exclusive Fan Meeting for the movie Under the Queen's Umbrella at the D-Cinema Landmark 81 complex.

The event will feature the special appearance of talented director Chang Hang Jun along with two passionately loved main actors: male god Park Ji-hoon and veteran actor Yoo Hai-jin.

Detailed event schedule:

  • 18:00 - 18:30: Event red carpet and souvenir photo taking at the main lobby of D-Cinema Landmark 81.
  • 18:30 - 19:30: Direct exchange with the film crew, listen to interesting behind-the-scenes stories and participate in mini-games to receive souvenirs.
  • 19:30 - 21:30: Premiere of the special screening of the movie and official poster signing for the first 100 customers buying Early Fan Meeting Combo tickets.

Tickets for this special event will be exclusively sold online on the D-Cinema website and app from 12:00 on June 17, 2026. Get ready to own a ticket to meet your idol!
